name: MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B thinking — official 4x projector condition

projector.quantization_note: The official file is named f16, but its actual GGUF file_type=32 and tensors are BF16/F32.

gguf_observed.method: Bounded HTTP Range read; decoded GGUF v3 metadata and complete tensor-info table; no inference

projector.method: Decoded a 65536-byte local prefix matching the official HTTP Range header; whole-file SHA verified independently on PC and Jetson

measurement_notes: RAM sampled every second; very short peaks may fall between samples.
RSS sums server and descendants, which can double-count shared pages.
Kernel reaped-child RSS is an individual high-water mark, not tree aggregate.
On unified-memory Jetson, CUDA memory may be absent from process RSS; inspect system RAM too.
Artifact SHA verification reads weights before startup and warms file cache.
Readiness and context capacity do not establish model quality or GPU parallelism.
